title: Markov — a Monte-Carlo Sampling Studio
description: Watch eight from-scratch MCMC samplers (Metropolis, MALA, HMC, NUTS, Gibbs, slice, adaptive, parallel tempering) explore nine tricky targets — including a real Bayesian logistic-regression posterior — in real time. Race two samplers head-to-head on the same seed with a live ESS/efficiency compare bar, auto-tune HMC/NUTS step sizes with Nesterov dual averaging, and share any experiment by link. Live diagnostics (ESS, split-R̂, autocorrelation, cost-aware efficiency), a long-exposure sample cloud, and CSV export.
